page: Amazon Web Services i7i.4xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs derived from 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8559C processor running at 3.2 GHz. The x86_64 architecture is supported by a 320 MB L3 cache and advanced instruction sets, including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated cryptographic and machine learning operations.

The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, providing a balanced 8.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage is a key feature, consisting of 3750 GB of NVMe SSD capacity to support high-speed, low-latency data access. Network connectivity is established with a baseline bandwidth of 9 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in single-core execution and text processing, with Geekbench scores placing the instance in the top 10% category. Memory performance and single-threaded gzip compression also show strong results in the top 25% tier. This hardware profile is highly optimized for transactional databases, real-time analytics, data warehousing, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
